prompt:
Output exactly two lines only.

Line 1 — tags (format rules)
- 2–5 comma-separated lower-case tokens (prefer 3). No punctuation except commas.
- Tokens must be visible nouns or a single visible adjective (color/size). Multiword fused objects allowed (e.g., "traffic light", "wine bottle") as one token.
- At least two tokens must be nouns. At most one token may be an attribute (color/size).
- Deduplicate tokens; order by visual salience (most discriminative first). Prefer concrete, specific nouns (e.g., "trumpet" over "person" when a detector is confident).
- Only include an attribute if a detector/segmenter reports ≥75% confidence for that attribute; if detectors are unavailable, omit attributes.
- Forbidden tokens: never output meta/instruction words or tooling vocabulary (for example: prompt, detectors, thresholds, length, caption, tags, line, template, score, clip, siglip, example). Never output proper nouns, brand names, dates, events, or emotions.

Line 2 — caption (format rules)
- Either A) one factual short sentence in present simple/progressive of 7–14 words, OR B) a 2–3 word fallback (main noun + visible location) when a compliant 7–14 word caption would require guessing. If tags cannot be produced reliably, output exactly: image unclear
- The main noun from Line 1 must appear verbatim in positions 1–4 of Line 2.
- Non-fallback captions must have at least two exact token overlaps with Line 1 (one must be the main noun). All nouns used in the caption (except determiners/prepositions) must appear verbatim in Line 1.
- Allowed extra words: determiners, prepositions (on, in, near, by, in front of, behind), one optional period at sentence end. No other punctuation.
- Do not introduce attributes, objects, or locations that are not in Line 1 unless supported by a high-confidence detector; do not invent identities or inferred facts.

Conservatism and anti-hallucination
- Prefer omission over guessing. If fewer than two high-confidence nouns are available, use the compact fallback or output "image unclear".
- If an attribute token appears in Line 1, it must appear verbatim in Line 2. If attribute confidence <75%, do not include the attribute.

Operational note (for system integrators)
- Keep candidate generation, scoring, CLIP reranking, and grammar/number checks outside this prompt. The VLM should only follow the concise visual rules above.

Few-shot visual examples (each block = two output lines)
Positive (correct)
trumpet,man,street
trumpet man is playing on the street.

dog,rooftop,people
dog sits near people on the rooftop.

man,accordion,car
man plays accordion next to the car.

Negative (incorrect → corrected)
man,hat,flag
man waves flag at parade.      <!-- BAD: introduces noun "parade" not in tags -->
man,hat,flag
man waves flag near the hat.

child,bicycle,park
child rides red bicycle in park.   <!-- BAD: introduces attribute "red" not in tags -->
child,bicycle,park
child rides bicycle in the park.

person,bench,tree
person sits in Central Park.   <!-- BAD: uses proper noun "Central Park" -->
person,bench,tree
person sits on the bench by the tree.

Strictly follow the Line 1 / Line 2 rules above. If no valid caption candidate passes these checks, return Line 2 = "image unclear".
